---
title: "Ask this site"
---

The **Ask** button at the bottom right of every page answers questions about
the group's research from what is published on this site. It runs entirely in
your browser. Nothing you type is sent to us or to anyone else.

## What it searches

- the pages of this site and new posts,
- the blog archive, 2009 to 2025,
- the [publication list](publications.qmd), one record per article with its
  authors, journal, year and DOI,
- summaries of the group's papers, written from the papers themselves, each
  with the citation of the paper it summarizes.

## How it works

Your question is matched against these passages with a keyword search (BM25)
in your browser, and the best matches are listed with links. That part works
in any browser.

If your browser supports WebGPU (a recent Chrome or Edge, Safari 26 or later,
or Firefox with WebGPU enabled), you can also click **Load model** to download
a small language model with [WebLLM](https://github.com/mlc-ai/web-llm). It is
downloaded once, cached by your browser, and runs on your own device. It then
writes an answer using only the passages that were found, citing them by
number.

## Limits

Small models make mistakes. Treat a written answer as a pointer to the
passages, and check the passages and the papers they cite before relying on
it. If nothing relevant is found, the assistant should say so rather than
answer from memory, but it is not guaranteed to.
